a: Upgraded GMRT time at 120-1460 MHz, including pulsar beamformer modes and the SPOTLIGHT FRB/pulsar backend; no funding
dt: Cycle 52 call not posted yet; GMRT's tentative schedule puts April-September proposal deadlines on 15 January. Cycle 51 closed 15 Jul 2026, 17:00 IST.
e: NCRA's twice-yearly call for the upgraded GMRT in India. The GMRT Time Allocation Committee reviews proposals on scientific merit and technical feasibility; PIs submit through the NAPS system, and the call states no nationality limit.
unv: Cycle 52 deadline not announced (15 Jan is GMRT's tentative date). The Cycle 51 call does not spell out eligibility for non-Indian PIs or grad-student PIs.
